speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent; please tell me, when you believe you are communicating telepathically with animals, do you feel others in the room can hear or understand this conversation as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Misidentification Syndrome (specifically with a delusion of control/communication with animals).

The patient reports a loss of telepathic ability previously possessed, now influenced by weather and unproven herbal remedies. Can you describe any specific thoughts or images you see that convince you animals are sending you messages, and do you have any auditory hallucinations as well?
